title: Successor compatibility of the fixed normalized decalage page isomorphisms.
statement: Let C be abelian and U a filtered cochain complex. For every r ≥ 2 and every chain map on page r whose components are the fixed normalized decalage page isomorphisms, the induced homology map commutes with the spectral and canonical successor isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_decalage_page_successor_coherence
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) :
    ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (f : ((filteredComplexCanonicalModel C).S.obj U).page r hr ⟶
      (((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).E₂SpectralSequence).page r hr),
    (∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ, f.f pq = (filteredComplexDecalagePageIso U pq.1 pq.2 r hr).hom) →
    ∀ pq : ℤ × ℤ,
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f pq ≫
          ((((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).E₂SpectralSequence).iso
            r (r + 1) pq rfl hr).hom =
        (((filteredComplexCanonicalModel C).S.obj U).iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr).hom ≫
          (filteredComplexDecalagePageIso U pq.1 pq.2 (r + 1) (by omega)).hom

proof.text: Cover successor cycles epimorphically; the spectral homology-data factorization and representative class transition identify both successor composites, and cancellation gives the result.
